gr064.title: Olympus 35 SP Rangefinder Film Camera G.Zuiko 42mm f/1.7
gr064.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
gr064.details: Olympus 35 SP 35mm rangefinder film camera with the G.Zuiko 42mm f/1.7 lens, a classic with a bright lens and spot metering. Condition: the top and bottom plates are clean; there is light paint wear on the front and back and a dent on the front frame of the lens barrel. The light seals in the film chamber have light deterioration. There is dust in the viewfinder, the double image and bright frame are somewhat faint but focusing works, the front lens has slight dust and the rear lens has light haze. The aperture blades are fine. The shutter fires at all speeds, and winding, rewinding, the frame counter, the focus ring and the aperture ring were confirmed. The meter needle moves, but its accuracy was not tested. It was not test-shot with film, so please consider it for use after servicing. Included: camera body and lens cap.
gr064.why: A used Olympus 35 SP rangefinder with a fast G.Zuiko 42mm f/1.7 lens.
gr064.perfect: Film photographers and collectors of classic rangefinder cameras.
gr064.exp: A pre-owned Olympus 35 SP with the condition described above.
gr064.cd: Pre-owned. Light paint wear on the front and back, a dent on the lens barrel frame, aged light seals, dust in the viewfinder, faint double image and bright frame, slight dust on the front lens and light haze on the rear lens. Shutter, winding, rewinding, frame counter, focus ring and aperture ring were checked. The meter needle moves but its accuracy was not tested. Not test-shot with film; for use after servicing. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
